title: Organize and complete your writing/story phase well ahead of Seedance 2…
content: Organize and complete your writing/story phase well ahead of Seedance 2 prompting to reduce strain and make the prompt-writing process smoother.
tips: Organize and complete your writing/story phase well ahead of Seedance 2 prompting to reduce strain and make the prompt-writing process smoother.

es.content: Organiza y completa bien tu fase de escritura/historia con suficiente antelación antes de crear prompts para Seedance 2, para reducir la carga y hacer que el proceso de redacción del prompt sea más fluido.

fr.content: Organisez et finalisez votre phase d’écriture/de narration bien avant la phase de prompting de Seedance 2 afin de réduire la charge de travail et de rendre le processus de rédaction du prompt plus fluide.

ja.content: Seedance 2 のプロンプト作成に入る前に、執筆／ストーリー段階を十分に整理し、完成させておくことで、負担を減らし、プロンプト作成のプロセスをよりスムーズにしましょう。

ko.content: Seedance 2 프롬프트 작성에 앞서 글쓰기/스토리 단계는 미리 충분히 정리하고 완성해 두어, 부담을 줄이고 프롬프트 작성 과정을 더 매끄럽게 만드세요.

pt.content: Organize e conclua bem antes a fase de escrita/história antes de criar prompts para o Seedance 2, para reduzir o esforço e tornar o processo de redação do prompt mais fluido.

zh.content: 在进行 Seedance 2 提示词编写之前，提前充分整理并完成你的写作/故事阶段，以减轻压力并让提示词撰写过程更加顺畅。
